claim_ceiling: Package identity derivation only; does not establish semantic correctness, legal validity, authority, or execution readiness.

normative_derivation.step_1: Read PACKAGE-MANIFEST.json and iterate manifest.members in the exact listed order.
normative_derivation.step_2: For each member construct exactly one identity object containing only path, bytes, sha256, and sha512, using the literal manifest values without path normalization or digest prefixes.
normative_derivation.step_3: Append each identity object to an array, preserving manifest.members order.
normative_derivation.step_4: Serialize that array as UTF-8 JSON with lexicographically sorted object keys, ensure_ascii=false, no indentation, separators exactly comma+space and colon+space, and no trailing newline.
normative_derivation.step_5: Compute SHA-256 over the exact serialized bytes; lowercase hexadecimal output is the package digest.

reference_implementation_equivalence.note: This published rule makes the aggregate digest independently reproducible without reading implementation source.
